resources.name: Nervum API
resources.description:
Import: Insomnia → Application menu → Import/Export → Import Data → From File → select this JSON.

Auth (pick one):
• Session: run Register or Login with Send Cookies enabled; API sets nervum_session.
• Service user: set environment variable service_token to NERVUM_SERVICE_TOKEN and add header Authorization: Bearer {{ service_token }} on requests (folder override or duplicate). Leave service_token empty when using cookies only.

Variables: fill organization_id, user_id, etc. in Base Environment. Paths use {{ base_url }} and {{ organization_id }} syntax.
